notes: Seasons are football seasons 2021-2026 (NIL era start: NCAA interim policy July 1, 2021).

Football 2021-2024 do not reuse FY2025 ticket/sponsorship/contribution dollars.
House cap only 2025-26 (20.5M reported) and 2026-27 (~21.3M estimated).
Rosters: data/rosters-YYYY.json from ESPN public JSON.
